bug_info.bug_desc: For AXI widths below the I-cache line width, icache_miss_rdata is directly assigned from the assembled response data. This path bypasses the address-based 64-bit lane selection required by uncacheable instruction reads, so the requested word may reach the I-cache in the wrong lane.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the direct raw-data assignment and route this configuration through the common uncacheable word-selection and right-alignment logic.
